name: process_xlsx_tool
description: Inspect a macro-free Microsoft Excel .xlsx workbook natively and read-only. It preserves sheets, cells, formulas, formula references, tables, and visual-object evidence without calculating formulas, executing scripts/macros, refreshing connections, or resolving external links.

document_path.description: S3 URI (s3://bucket/key) or absolute local path to a macro-free .xlsx source workbook.

session_id.description: Runtime session ID. A deterministic session-scoped artifact prefix is used when supplied.

job_id.description: Identifier of the active analysis run.

result.description: JSON summary containing the final canonical BADGERS XML content-tree URI, private workbook-analysis JSON URI, sheet count, warnings, and conditional embedded-raster Vision status. Native cells and formulas remain authoritative.
